plugin_desc: SNMP monitoring template for Meru WLAN controller. It reports uptime, CPU utilization, memory utilization, and interface traffic (enterprise PEN 15983). Chassis temperature, fan and PSU are not collected.
name: Wireless

metrics.name: device_cpu_usage
metrics.description: CPU utilization of the Meru WLAN controller, computed as 100 minus idle percent when idle is in 0-100, otherwise user plus system when both are in range. Sustained high CPU usage can affect WLAN management responsiveness.

metrics.name: device_memory_usage
metrics.description: Memory utilization of the Meru WLAN controller, computed as used/total x 100 from mwSystemResource memory sizes. High memory pressure can degrade controller services.

metrics.name: device_memory_total
metrics.description: Total memory of the Meru WLAN controller in bytes (mwSystemResourceMemoryTotalSize, KB converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_used
metrics.description: Used memory of the Meru WLAN controller in bytes (mwSystemResourceMemoryUsedSize, KB converted to bytes).

metrics.name: device_memory_free
metrics.description: Free memory of the Meru WLAN controller in bytes (mwSystemResourceMemoryFreeSize, KB converted to bytes).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCInOctets
metrics.description: This metric indicates the average rate of bytes received over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCInOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: interface_ifHCOutOctets
metrics.description: This metric calculates the average rate of bytes sent over the past 5 minutes, measured in bytes per second, from the 64-bit IF-MIB ifHCOutOctets counter (ifXTable).

metrics.name: snmp_uptime
metrics.description: This metric indicates the uptime of the device since the last restart. By monitoring the uptime, network administrators can understand the stability and reliability of the device and identify potential reboot or failure issues.
